llm.summary: This skill is a Chinese K-12 classroom interaction coach that uses lesson and class data in a disclosed, purpose-aligned way and does not ship executable code.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses sensitive educational context about students, but the fields are disclosed, education-purpose aligned, and constrained toward aliases, tiers, aggregate observations, and no student names in classroom logs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown and JSON reference material only; no executable scripts, package installs, remote payload retrieval, or tool-wrapping behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions define adjacent requests to route elsewhere, prohibit writing lesson plans or student-tier analysis, and limit writeback to aggregate classroom interaction logs after teacher confirmation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It depends on platform memory and writes interactionLogs, but requires generated pending entries confirmed by the teacher and exposes view, correction, deletion, pause, sharing, and export controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is classroom interaction coaching; reading lesson plans, class profile, student tiers, and weakness summaries is directly tied to tailoring questions, grouping, timing, and cold-call avoidance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this for Chinese-language mainland China K-12 classroom use where teachers are comfortable letting the skill read lesson plans, student tier aliases, and weakness summaries. Review platform permissions so only confirmed aggregate classroom observations are written back, and localize language, grade bands, consent rules, and crisis resources before using it in other regions.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The activation examples are broad classroom-interaction phrases, but SKILL.md also lists non-owned adjacent requests and says activation is suggested, so this is a routing-quality note rather than a security concern.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese language and China K-12 taxonomy are intentional: shared/platform-conventions.md states the library is designed for mainland China Chinese K-12 use and requires localization before deployment elsewhere.
[SDI-1] expected: The schema includes lessonPlans, but SKILL.md repeatedly limits this skill to reading objectives/questionChain/segments and states it must not write lessonPlans.
[SDI-2] expected: The schema includes studentTiers and weaknessRank, but those are used to adapt participation paths and questioning focus; SKILL.md assigns ownership of those fields to student-analyzer and restricts this skill to read-only use.
